description.value: Starting at 5th level, you can use your action to transform into a shape that is a hybrid of your current and past life in order to gain all of the remaining traits and abilities of your past life’s branch race (i.e. those not already gained through Synthesis) including any forms of movement and special senses. If the branch race is normally of a size different from yours, you choose which of the two sizes to be for the duration. This transformation lasts until you fall unconscious or you choose to transform back as an action.
